## Dice Guessing - a simple multi-player game...

[Two people send guesses about a dice roll from their laptops]

[I roll a dice with `np.random.randint(1, 7)` then use conditionals to say who won (who is *closer* to roll), and to keep score]

```{python active="", eval=FALSE}
# Get IP (each student runs this)
import socket

hostname = socket.gethostname()
ip = socket.gethostbyname(hostname)

print(ip)
```

```{python active="", eval=FALSE}
# Teacher 
import socket

HOST = "0.0.0.0"
PORT = 5000

with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as server:
    server.bind((HOST, PORT))
    server.listen(2)

    print(f"Listening to port {PORT}...")

    for _ in range(2):
        conn, address = server.accept()

        with conn:
            data = conn.recv(1024).decode()
            print(f"Student {address}: {data}")
```

```{python active="", eval=FALSE}
# Student
import socket

TEACHER_IP = "192.168.1.169" 

PORT = 5000

name = input("Your name: ")
guess = input("Guess the dice roll (1-6): ")

message = f"{name}: {guess}"

with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as client:
    client.connect((TEACHER_IP, PORT))
    client.sendall(message.encode())

print("Guess sent!")
```
